description:
**About ValGenesis**
ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle.
  
  
Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about
  
  
About the Role:
  
  
**We’re on a Mission**
In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world’s first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard.
  
  
Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end-to-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose-built systems with world-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations.
  
  
**The Team You’ll Join**
Our customers’ success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity’s quality of life, and we honor that mission.
  
  
We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done.
  
  
We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward.
  
  
We’re in it to win it. We’re on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won’t settle for anything less than being a market leader.
  
  
**How We Work**
Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.
  
  
ValGenesis is an equal-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company: EVOCS
  
  
Location: Mumbai/ Noida, Hybrid
  
  
Experience:3–4 years
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
Velloe – an EVOCS Company is looking for a Junior Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team and work across our headless, multi-platform product architecture. Our stack pairs a Drupal 10 headless CMS with a Next.js 14 web portal and React Native mobile apps for iOS and Android, all sharing synchronized state, unified data contracts, and end-to-end AES-256-CBC payload encryption. You'll work across mobile, web, and backend layers, contributing to features that span our entire platform rather than sitting in a single silo.
  
  
This role suits someone with 3–4 years of hands-on development experience who is comfortable moving between a React Native codebase, a Next.js frontend, and a PHP/Drupal backend, and who wants to keep building breadth across a modern, security-conscious stack.
  
  
**What You'll Work With**
Our architecture is headless and decoupled: Drupal 10 serves content and business logic through REST and GraphQL APIs, consumed by a Next.js 14 web portal and React Native 0.78 mobile apps. All three layers share unified data contracts and encrypt API payloads end-to-end with AES-256-CBC.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain features across our React Native (iOS & Android), Next.js web, and Drupal backend codebases, depending on sprint needs.
* Implement UI screens and components using React Native Paper, Reanimated, and React Navigation on mobile, and React with Tailwind CSS on web.
* Integrate with REST and GraphQL APIs exposed by our Drupal 10 backend, including handling CSRF token injection, authenticated requests, and AES-256-CBC encrypted payloads.
* Manage application state using Redux Toolkit and RTK Query, including offline persistence via redux-persist and AsyncStorage on mobile.
* Build and validate forms using React Hook Form and Yup on the web portal.
* Implement and troubleshoot push notifications, deep linking, and local/remote notification handling using Firebase Cloud Messaging and Notifee.
* Contribute to backend features in Drupal 10 (PHP 8.2), including custom REST endpoints, GraphQL schema/resolvers, and content model changes.
* Work with MySQL 8.0 for data modeling, queries, and performance tuning as needed.
* Integrate third-party services such as Razorpay (payments), FingerprintJS (device fraud prevention), Google Analytics 4, Firebase Crashlytics, and Vimeo/YouTube video embeds.
* Support release processes: generate Android `.aab`/`.apk` builds via Gradle and iOS `.ipa` builds via Xcode Archive, and assist with manual submissions to Google Play Console and TestFlight/App Store.
* Write clean, typed code in TypeScript across mobile and web, following our ESLint/Prettier standards and Conventional Commits via Husky and Commitizen.
* Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and cross-functional discussions with design, QA, and product.
* Debug and resolve issues across the stack, using tools like Firebase Crashlytics and network/API debugging to trace problems from client to backend.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–4 years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated work across both frontend and backend, or frontend and mobile.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with practical experience writing typed, interface-driven code.
* Hands-on experience with React (web) and ideally React Native for mobile app development.
* Working knowledge of Redux or Redux Toolkit for state management, including async data fetching patterns (RTK Query or similar).
* Experience consuming REST APIs; exposure to GraphQL is a plus.
* Familiarity with a server-side language such as PHP, and comfort working with a CMS or backend framework (Drupal experience is a strong plus, but not required if you're comfortable picking it up).
* Basic to intermediate SQL and relational database experience (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar).
* Understanding of Git workflows, including feature branching, pull requests, and code review practices.
* Familiarity with authentication/security concepts such as token-based auth, CSRF protection, or payload encryption (AES-256 or similar) is a plus.
* Ability to work across the mobile, web, and backend layers of a project, and willingness to learn unfamiliar parts of the stack.
* Good communication skills and comfort collaborating in a cross-functional agile team.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Next.js (App Router) and Tailwind CSS.
* Experience with Drupal or another headless/decoupled CMS.
* Exposure to Firebase services (FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics).
* Experience integrating payment gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, or similar.
* Familiarity with mobile release processes (Gradle builds, Xcode Archive, Play Console/App Store submissions).
* Experience with mapping libraries (Leaflet, Google Maps) or media/video integrations (React Player, PDF.js, Vimeo/YouTube APIs).
* Exposure to AWS S3 or other cloud object storage for media/asset handling.

**Tools & Practices You'll Use**
Bitbucket for version control, Husky pre-commit hooks with Commitizen for Conventional Commits, ESLint and Prettier for code quality, and Composer for backend dependency management.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Portfolio or prior project experience demonstrating full-stack or cross-platform development work.

title: Software Engineer (Frontend / Full Stack)
description:
**About InterviewGlide**

InterviewGlide is a desktop app for Mac and Windows that helps people do better in job interviews. During a practice or live interview, it hears the question and shows a clear, short answer on screen in real time. More products are on the way.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a software engineer who cares about how a product looks and feels as much as how it works. Two kinds of profile fit this role, and we welcome both:

* **Frontend / UI-UX:**
  you turn rough ideas into clean, fast and accessible interfaces, and you sweat the details people notice.
* **Full stack:**
  you are just as happy designing an API and a database table as building the screen on top of it.

**What you’ll do**

* **Build and polish product UIs:**
  the web app, the website and new products. Responsive, accessible and fast on every screen size.
* **Design the flows:**
  sign-up, onboarding, settings, billing and everything in between. Sketch in Figma or go straight to code.
* **Care about every state:**
  loading, empty, error and success, on desktop and on mobile.
* **Grow the design system:**
  shared components, type, spacing and motion that keep everything consistent.
* **Ship features end to end:**
  API, data, UI and tests, then watch how people really use them.
* **Help start new products:**
  move from idea to a working first version quickly.

**Who you are**

* 1+ years building and shipping web products, or equivalent proof: things you built that people actually use.
* **Freshers are welcome to apply:**
  strong projects count as much as years.
* Strong with TypeScript, React and modern CSS.
* A good eye for design: you notice when spacing, copy or a flow feels off, and you fix it.
* For the full stack side: comfortable with Node.js APIs, SQL databases and auth.
* You write tests, read errors carefully, and leave code clearer than you found it.
* You work well remotely: you ask early, write down decisions and finish what you start.

**Nice to have**

* Figma skills or a design portfolio.
* Animation and micro-interactions that make an interface feel alive.
* Experience with desktop apps (for example Electron), browser extensions or real-time features.
* Payments, auth or AI features you have shipped.
* A side project or open-source work you can show.

**What we offer**

* Fully remote, flexible hours.
* Real ownership and fast decisions.
* Full-time role with a fixed salary.
* A say in what gets built next, across several products.

**How to apply**

Along with your application, share a link to something you built or designed (a live product, repo or portfolio) and what your part was.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**About Aervon**

Aervon is a SpaceTech and DeepTech accelerator connecting founders across India and the United States. We work with early-stage companies in SpaceTech, aerospace, defense, AI, robotics, and advanced manufacturing.

Built by MLVN Ventures, Aervon runs on a founder-first model: no fees, no equity. We give founders expertise, networks, and strategic support, and we build the technology that makes that support scale.

**The Role**

We're hiring a Software Engineer to build the systems Aervon runs on — the platform founders and partners use, the internal tools our team depends on, and the data and AI infrastructure behind our research on the DeepTech ecosystem.

Most of your work will be backend: services and APIs, data pipelines, third-party integrations, and LLM-powered internal applications. You'll own projects end to end, from problem statement to production. This is a small team, so you'll make architecture decisions rather than inherit them.

You do not need an aerospace or space background. You do need to be comfortable learning unfamiliar technical domains quickly, because you'll be working alongside founders building hardware, autonomy systems, and frontier technology.

**What You'll Do**

- Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that hold up in production.

- Build and maintain data pipelines feeding Aervon's platform and research work.

- Integrate third-party APIs and services across our stack.

- Build internal tools and automation that remove manual work from how the team operates.

- Develop AI/LLM-backed features: retrieval, enrichment, summarization, agent workflows.

- Own quality: tests, code review, monitoring, and debugging production issues.

- Participate in CI/CD, deployment, and release processes.

- Write the design docs and documentation that let the next engineer move fast.

- Work directly with founders, engineers, and partners on technical initiatives.

**What You'll Need**

- 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with production systems you've shipped and maintained.

- Strong fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and software design.

- Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, C++, or a comparable modern language.

- Solid backend and REST API experience.

- Working knowledge of SQL and relational data modeling.

- Fluency with Git and collaborative development workflows.

- Strong debugging instincts and the ability to work from an ambiguous problem statement to a shipped solution.

- Clear written communication and the discipline to work independently in a remote, distributed team.

- A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to Have**

- Python, TypeScript, or C++ specifically.

- Hands-on work with LLMs, generative AI, computer vision, or ML systems in production.

- Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Docker.

- CI/CD and DevOps practice; distributed systems or microservices.

- Robotics, simulation, autonomy, embedded systems, or hardware-software integration.

- Exposure to aerospace, SpaceTech, defense, advanced manufacturing, or other DeepTech domains.

- Startup or early-stage experience.

- Open-source contributions, side projects, research, or technical writing we can read.

**Why This Role**

Software engineering at Aervon sits next to a broader technology ecosystem. You'll see the problems SpaceTech, robotics, and defense startups are actually solving, and build tools that touch them.

The role is designed for engineers who want to build new systems rather than maintain existing ones - new products, new tooling, emerging technologies, and direct work with ambitious founders across India and the US.

**Working Here**

- Remote, based in India. You choose where you work from.

- Distributed team across India and the US. Expect a few hours of overlap with US time zones each week for collaboration - not a fixed night shift.

- Compensation: ₹12,00,000–₹18,00,000 per annum, set by experience and demonstrated engineering ability.
